description: This file is a shell script used to test the 'post-rewrite' hook functionality in a Git repository. It sets up commits, performs various git operations such as amend, rebase, and cherry-pick, and verifies that the hook is invoked correctly with the expected input data.

methods.name: clear_hook_input
methods.description: Removes any existing post-rewrite hook input files.

methods.name: verify_hook_input
methods.description: Compares the current hook input files against expected content to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_fail_interactive_rebase
methods.description: Helper function to perform an interactive rebase with predefined input lines, expecting failure.
